other_conditions: Institute must be AICTE‑approved and have existed for at least 8 years
Coordinator must be a full‑time regular Associate Professor or Professor (or senior faculty) with a minimum of 10 years of teaching/research experience and publications
Coordinator must have organized at least three conferences for an international conference or at least one conference for a national conference
Co‑coordinator must be a faculty member with at least 7 years of teaching/research experience and must have organized at least one conference for an international conference
The department organizing the conference should preferably be NBA accredited
Onsite conferences require at least 15% participation from other states; online conferences require at least 25% participation from other states
Papers from the host institution must not exceed 10% of the total papers submitted
Institute can receive the grant only once in two years
Institute must post the AICTE scheme link on its website and on the conference webpage
10% of the sanctioned funds must be utilized for registration fees of SC/ST participants
Coordinator must maintain an electronic record of papers, participants and their institutions and host a dedicated conference webpage on the institute’s site
benefits_summary: Up to ₹3,00,000 for national onsite conferences, up to ₹4,00,000 for international onsite conferences, and up to ₹50,000 for online conferences (national or international), each covering one‑third of eligible expenses.
